purpose: Department voices, keyed by four style axes (project decision, Entry 024: not by department names). The seed sampler assigns one profile to each department slot; S2 maps the case's real departments onto those slots. Findings are always plain; the profile governs the assessment section and any document the department authors. Exemplars are nonsense and show syntax only.

profiles.bias: Trusts the record over the person. If it is not logged, it did not happen; if it is logged, it is true.
exemplars: Item FIXTURE-03 received 09:10. Seal intact. Mass 212 g. No record of transfer in register FIXTURE-R2. Transfer did not occur.
Entry FIXTURE-07 recorded as complete at 16:42. Countersignature present. Per entry, procedure FIXTURE-P1 followed in full.

profiles.bias: Looks for equipment, process or environment before intent. Reluctant to blame a person while any mechanical explanation remains.
exemplars: The surface of FIXTURE-05 shows a pattern consistent with ordinary wear, although we cannot exclude a single event of the kind described in FIXTURE-R4, and we would want a second sample before saying more.

We note that the reading at FIXTURE-09 sits just outside tolerance, which in our experience more often reflects the calibration of the instrument than anything done to it, though we cannot exclude handling.

profiles.bias: Reads intent into behaviour and defers to rank. Assumes the senior account is the reliable one.
exemplars: Person A evidently chose to leave FIXTURE-02 unattended, which is in keeping with the account given by the senior officer of FIXTURE-D1, and I see no reason to doubt it.
The sequence at FIXTURE-11 was clearly intended to be read as routine; the reliable account here is the supervisor's, and the junior statement adds little.

profiles.bias: Sympathises with the junior or vulnerable party and discounts their culpability; notices pressure on people.
exemplars: Person B may have missed FIXTURE-04. Workload that week was high. Unsupported on two shifts. Understandably slow to report.
Note: FIXTURE-08 was filed late. Person C likely felt unable to raise it. Recommend no action on the delay itself.
